properties/path: Workspace-relative or absolute path, subject to the current Workspace Access mode.
properties/old_string: Exact substring to replace, including indentation.
properties/new_string: Replacement text. Use an empty string to delete.
properties/replace_all: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match.
properties/edits: Replacements matched against the original file. Merge overlapping targets.
properties/edits/items/properties/old_st: Exact substring to replace within the original file, including indentation.
